analyst_view.overall: Nacional are low in the table and on their third coach of the season. João Henriques has made them hard to break down with a back five, and lost his debut only 1-0 at Arouca. He has now also lost defender Léo Santos for the rest of the season with a serious injury. Bruno Pinheiro's Académico de Viseu are sixth and like to pass the ball on the ground, but heavy rain and strong wind are forecast for Funchal on Saturday. Henriques says both teams will have to adapt.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. Henriques's Nacional are built to defend first, and Pinheiro admits they have 'closed the doors' to their goal. Nacional have scored only four in six and are missing Léo Santos, Liziero, Wesley Gasolina, Ulisses and Filipe Soares. Heavy rain and wind are also expected to disrupt Viseu's short-passing game, which points to a low-scoring match.

corners.text: The numbers say about 8.8 corners. Viseu may have most of the ball against a deep Nacional block, and wet conditions can lead to more scrambled clearances. On the other hand, the model gives Nacional the larger home share, which seems unlikely if they sit deep. These factors roughly cancel out.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, with Pedro Ramalho refereeing. A heavy pitch can bring late, mistimed tackles, but a patient game against a deep defence doesn't usually produce many bookings. We found no disciplinary news for either side.

shots.text: The numbers say almost 30 shots, which looks high. Nacional's back five is set up to limit openings, Pinheiro expects a slow, patient build-up, and rain and wind make clean shooting chances harder to create.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Viseu's coach expects to struggle to create clear chances against Nacional's new set-up. Nacional's attack has been weak, and Henriques says their final pass and decision-making still need work.
